content: The FIDELIO-DKD and FIGARO-DKD clinical trials specifically investigated the efficacy of finerenone in patients with type 2 diabetes who also have diabetic kidney disease. These studies demonstrated that finerenone significantly reduces the risk of adverse cardiovascular events, including hospitalizations due to heart failure, in this high-risk patient population. The findings from these trials provide strong evidence supporting the use of finerenone as an effective therapeutic option for managing complications associated with diabetic kidney disease.
